candidate_windows.window_text: We use the Huggingface $^{13}$ implementations of the BERT and RoBERTa models. We tune the learning rate in $\{1e-6, 2e-6, 5e-6, 1e-5, 2e-5\}$ based on F1 on the devset, and find 2e-6 works best for our best performing RoBERTa-large model. All models are trained within 1.5 hours on one NVIDIA A40 GPU.
